events.title: Board Game Café x IDA
events.summary: Dinner, snacks, and board games in Softwarezonen in collaboration with IDA.
events.description: Bring your fellow students for an evening packed with classic and modern board games, dinner, and snacks sponsored by IDA. All software students are welcome.

events.title: Integrating LLMs in Workflows x IDA
events.summary: Academic workshop on practical use and integration of LLMs in development workflows.
events.description: Technical talk and hands-on workshop in collaboration with IDA focusing on how modern language models can be integrated safely and effectively into software workflows. Dinner and snacks included.

events.title: Game Jam with Spiltek
events.summary: Week 46 weekend game jam where teams build games from scratch with prizes and food.
events.description: A full weekend of creativity, coding, and game development together with Spiltek, IDA, and PROSA. Join with or without a team, build a game over the weekend, and compete for prizes.

events.title: Dungeons & Dragons – One Shot
events.summary: Full-day adventure with dice and pizza for both beginners and experienced players.
events.description: Dive into a ready-to-play D&D one-shot adventure led by Enigma's DMs. Pre-generated characters are available, pizza is served for dinner, and both newcomers and veterans are welcome.

events.title: Karaoke at Studenterhuset
events.summary: Sing along or cheer from the bar at Enigma's karaoke night at Studenterhuset.
events.description: A festive Thursday evening at Studenterhuset where we warm up our vocal cords and hang out across all semesters with drink tickets and great vibes.

events.title: Board Game Café
events.summary: A cozy December evening with board games, dinner, and snacks before exam prep.
events.description: Enigma invites all software students to a relaxed evening of board games, card games, dinner, and snacks in Softwarezonen. Bring your study group or drop by solo.

events.title: Christmas Party (Julefrokost)
events.summary: Annual Christmas party with dinner, gift exchange, prizes, and celebration across all years.
events.description: As tradition goes, we wrap up the fall semester with Enigma's big Christmas party at Nedenunder in collaboration with IDA and Bankdata. Look forward to great food, pakkeleg, prizes, and a party with the whole program.
